description: arXiv:2609.29692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fair allocation of scarce, indivisible resources is an important challenge in many societal problems. As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions and act as agents, they raise new concerns about distributional justice:...
